summary.text: Zhou Zhong is a rank six featherman Gu Immortal of Sacred Feather City who urges Zheng Ling to abandon a green heaven fragment world under siege.

claims.text: Sacred Feather City had three Gu Immortals. One is already dead. Zheng Ling remains at rank seven. Zhou Zhong is in worse condition after the siege than Zheng Ling. He names the small world a fragment world of green heaven among the immemorial nine heavens, isolated and a paradise, and says variant humans have no place to live while humans rule the world. He and Zheng Ling gather the remaining feathermen and use the immortal killer move heavenly wish. Tens of thousands shout, pure white light rises over the city, and a force teleports them away. He arrives in Tai Bai Yun Sheng’s blessed land as an earthly calamity, looks around with vigilance, and is shocked that their enemies are still Gu Immortals.
He is a featherman Gu Immortal. His expression is solemn.
In a flying speed duel against Tai Bai Yun Sheng he has wings, and he also has an immortal killer move used for movement. Zheng Ling’s speed is twice his.

He admits defeat in the last duel, breathing roughly and drenched in sweat. His expression is pale. Fang Yuan says that having won the tenth duel, he can choose slaves from the feathermen on the ground. Zhou Zhong sighs, looks at the clansmen on the ground, and his fingers stab into his flesh. Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng then descend and pick slaves. A featherman youngster is wounded. Zhou Zhong lands, presses on the youngster’s chest, and heals him. Fang Yuan names Zhou Zhong as a slave under the agreement that slaves be chosen from feathermen on the ground. Zhou Zhong is standing on the ground. His expression turns from pale as paper to dark and solemn. His wings flutter and he wants to raise his legs. He opens his mouth wide.

He shakes his head three times, turns to the feathermen, and bows. He says this world has the Gu Immortal Zhou Zhong and the featherman Zhou Zhong, and will not have a slave Zhou Zhong. He spreads his wings. The wings of feathermen are not wide like eagle wings or thick like vulture wings, but slender and exquisite. He flaps his wings and flies toward the sky, shouting that he is a featherman and will not become a slave. He violates the agreement. The information path immortal killer move on him erupts and the backlash assaults his entire body. The more he flies the slower he becomes, and his two wings become difficult to move. His flying looks like an old man approaching death, stumbling on his legs while still climbing a precipitous peak.

His whole body starts crystallizing rapidly, and he turns into a transparent glass crystal statue. His two wings turn into crystal glass like objects and move no longer. His eyes still gaze at the blue sky, carrying endless bravery and decisiveness. He falls. His body crumbles while falling: first his head, then his chest, his wings, stomach, then his legs. Before he lands he has turned into a sheet of broken glass and crystal fragments. The fragments flutter, crumble, and disintegrate in the air. Yu Fei calls him old ancestor Zhou Zhong and follows.

In Fang Yuan’s previous life he laid a trap that made the feathermen suicide, and he obtained only Zheng Ling’s soul. Those memories of the defense of Sacred Feather City are still clear. This is the same siege in this life. Zhou Zhong happens to be restricted by an immortal killer move and cannot budge, which is the chance Fang Yuan uses.

The battle has lasted two days. His eyes are bloodshot. He flies to a hole in the city wall. Two Gu Immortals flank him. He is severely injured and on the verge of death. An immortal killer move binds him so he cannot budge. They strike his chest. He spits out huge amounts of blood, is sent flying, crashes through constructions, and lies motionless on a pile of rubble. His body shakes slightly as he struggles. Yu Fei calls him old ancestor. There are countless injuries on his body, all inflicted by immortal killer moves, filled with dao marks. His eyes protrude. Fang Yuan uses slavery Immortal Gu and turns him into a slave. He moves his heavily injured body, flying toward the center of the city. He shouts that he will guard the Immortal Gu House, his whole body bathed in blood.

Slavery Immortal Gu at rank six can only enslave a rank six Gu Immortal. He takes control of Sacred Feather City. After heavenly wish he stands vigilantly in Tai Bai Yun Sheng’s blessed land. In this life he is a hidden traitor. Under his lead the feathermen move to Star Form blessed land.

Fang Yuan sends him to tail the fleeing Hei Cheng in secret, instructing him to follow without engaging, and the tailing succeeds. Fang Yuan later brings him along with Tai Bai Yun Sheng, using Fixed Immortal Travel to reach the deepest part of Luo Po valley.
Fang Yuan later sends him, the featherman Gu Immortal slave, to Western Desert to set up another plan.
